store-sales.title: Weekly units sold by a UK online gift shop, December 2009 to November 2011

sample.holds: 30 steady-selling products, 104 weeks of units sold per week (weeks start on Monday)

store-sales.full: Every product in the order log, 4,669 of them, in the same weekly layout
store-sales.credit: Chen, D. (2012). Online Retail II [Dataset]. UCI Machine Learning Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C5CG6D
store-sales.changes: Order lines summed into units per product and week, with cancelled orders subtracted and totals below zero set to zero. Postage, fees and other non-product lines removed. The nine days repeated across the two sheets counted once. Weeks with no orders set to zero; the first and last weeks, which the log cuts short, dropped. Product names put in sentence case.

bitcoin.title: Daily Bitcoin price in US dollars, July 2010 to July 2021
bitcoin.full: The price and 17 other daily series, such as transactions, hash rate, search interest and tweets

source.name: Bitcoin Dataset without Missing Values
source.publisher: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive, on Zenodo

bitcoin.credit: Godahewa, R., Bergmeir, C., Webb, G., Hyndman, R., & Montero-Manso, P. (2021). Bitcoin Dataset without Missing Values (Version 1) [Dataset]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5122101. The figures were collected from https://bitinfocharts.com.
bitcoin.changes: Converted from the archive's .tsf file to a table with one row per day. The sample keeps the price only. Days the source had no figure for were already filled with the last known value by the archive.

airline-passengers.title: Monthly international airline passengers in thousands, 1949 to 1960

source.name: AirPassengers
source.publisher: R datasets package, as a CSV file in Rdatasets

airline-passengers.credit: Box, G. E. P., Jenkins, G. M., & Reinsel, G. C. (1994). Time Series Analysis: Forecasting and Control (3rd ed.), series G. Distributed with R's datasets package and by Rdatasets (https://github.com/vincentarelbundock/Rdatasets).
airline-passengers.changes: The fractional-year column replaced by the month, and the value column named passengers.

spare-parts.title: Monthly sales of car spare parts, January 1998 to March 2002

sample.holds: 314 parts, 51 months of units sold per month

spare-parts.full: All 2,674 parts; 165 of them have no figures from early 1999 on

source.name: Car Parts Dataset (with Missing Values)
source.publisher: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive, on Zenodo

spare-parts.credit: Godahewa, R., Bergmeir, C., Webb, G., Hyndman, R., & Montero-Manso, P. (2020). Car Parts Dataset (with Missing Values) (Version 2) [Dataset]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4656022. The archive took the series from the R package expsmooth.
spare-parts.changes: Converted from the archive's .tsf file to a table with one row per month and one column per part, under the archive's part labels. The sample keeps every eighth part among the 2,509 that have a figure for every month.

city-temperatures.title: Daily highest temperature at Australian weather stations, May 2015 to April 2017

sample.holds: Eight cities, 725 days: Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide, Canberra, Hobart, Perth, Brisbane and Darwin

city-temperatures.full: All 422 stations, under the Bureau of Meteorology's station numbers

source.name: Temperature Rain Dataset with Missing Values
source.publisher: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive, on Zenodo

city-temperatures.credit: Bureau of Meteorology, Australian Government: Historical rainfall and temperature forecast and observations hourly data - weather forecasting verification data (2015-05 to 2016-04), and Rainfall and temperature forecast and observations - verification 2016-05 to 2017-04, both on data.gov.au. Put together as one file by Godahewa, R., Bergmeir, C., Webb, G., Hyndman, R., & Montero-Manso, P. (2021). Temperature Rain Dataset with Missing Values (Version 1) [Dataset]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5129073
city-temperatures.changes: The highest temperature of each day taken from the archive's .tsf file; its other series left out. The sample keeps eight stations and names each column after its city.

electricity-demand.title: Half-hourly electricity demand in Victoria, Australia, 2014

sample.holds: The whole year, 17,520 half-hours of demand in gigawatts

source.name: Electricity Demand (Elecdemand) Dataset
source.publisher: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive, on Zenodo

electricity-demand.credit: Godahewa, R., Bergmeir, C., Webb, G., Hyndman, R., & Montero-Manso, P. (2020). Electricity Demand (Elecdemand) Dataset (Version 2) [Dataset]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4656069. The archive took the series from the R package fpp2.
electricity-demand.changes: Converted from the archive's .tsf file and rounded to three decimals, which is one megawatt. The file holds one row per day and one column per half-hour; the loader returns one row per half-hour.

hospital-patients.title: Monthly patient counts for medical products, January 2000 to December 2006

sample.holds: 114 products, 84 months of patients per month

source.name: Hospital Dataset
source.publisher: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive, on Zenodo

hospital-patients.credit: Godahewa, R., Bergmeir, C., Webb, G., Hyndman, R., & Montero-Manso, P. (2020). Hospital Dataset (Version 2) [Dataset]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4656014. The archive took the series from the R package expsmooth.
hospital-patients.changes: Converted from the archive's .tsf file to a table with one row per month and one column per product, under the archive's labels. The sample keeps every second product among the 227 with at least 100 patients a month on average.

london-air.title: Hourly fine particles (PM2.5) at 24 air quality monitors in London, January 2017 to March 2018

sample.holds: 24 monitors, 3,624 hours from 1 November 2017 to 31 March 2018; a cell is empty where a monitor reported nothing

london-air.full: The same 24 monitors for all 15 months, 10,920 hours

source.name: KDD Cup Dataset (with Missing Values)
source.publisher: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive, on Zenodo

london-air.credit: Godahewa, R., Bergmeir, C., Webb, G., Hyndman, R., & Montero-Manso, P. (2020). KDD Cup Dataset (with Missing Values) (Version 4) [Dataset]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4656719. The archive took the series from the data of the KDD Cup 2018 forecasting competition; the London readings in it were made by the London Air Quality Network.
london-air.changes: The fine-particle (PM2.5) series of the 24 London monitors taken from the archive's .tsf file, one column per monitor under the network's site code; the Beijing series and the other measurements left out. Nothing filled in. The sample keeps the last five months.

rain.title: Daily rain, temperature and the official chance of rain at Australian weather stations, May 2015 to April 2017

sample.holds: Sydney (Observatory Hill), station 66062: 725 days of rain, highest and lowest temperature, and the Bureau of Meteorology's chance of rain for each day as forecast 0 to 5 days before

rain.full: The same nine columns for all 422 stations, with the station number above each column

source.name: Temperature Rain Dataset with Missing Values
source.publisher: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive, on Zenodo

rain.credit: Bureau of Meteorology, Australian Government: Historical rainfall and temperature forecast and observations hourly data - weather forecasting verification data (2015-05 to 2016-04), and Rainfall and temperature forecast and observations - verification 2016-05 to 2017-04, both on data.gov.au. Put together as one file by Godahewa, R., Bergmeir, C., Webb, G., Hyndman, R., & Montero-Manso, P. (2021). Temperature Rain Dataset with Missing Values (Version 1) [Dataset]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.5129073
rain.changes: Rain, highest and lowest temperature and the chance of rain taken from the archive's .tsf file; its other series left out. Each forecast moved from the day it was issued to the day it is for. Columns renamed. Days without a figure left empty. The sample keeps one station.

river-flow.title: Daily flow of the Saugeen River at Walkerton, Ontario, 1915 to 1979

sample.holds: The daily mean flow in cubic meters per second for 1950 to 1979, 10,957 days

river-flow.full: The same series from 1 January 1915, 23,741 days

source.name: Saugeen River Flow (SaugeenDay) Dataset
source.publisher: Monash Time Series Forecasting Archive, on Zenodo

river-flow.credit: Godahewa, R., Bergmeir, C., Webb, G., Hyndman, R., & Montero-Manso, P. (2020). Saugeen River Flow (SaugeenDay) Dataset (Version 2) [Dataset]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.4656058. The archive took the series from the R package deseasonalize.
river-flow.changes: Converted from the archive's .tsf file to a table with one row per day. The sample keeps 1950 to 1979.

sp500.title: The S&P 500 share index, 1950 to 2015

sample.holds: The closing level on the last trading day of each week, 3,444 weeks ending on Fridays from 6 January 1950 to 1 January 2016

sp500.full: Open, high, low, close and volume for each of the 16,607 trading days, on a calendar of business days with empty rows where the market was closed

source.name: sp500
source.publisher: R package gt, as a CSV file in Rdatasets

sp500.credit: Iannone, R., Cheng, J., Schloerke, B., and others. gt: Easily Create Presentation-Ready Display Tables (R package, Posit Software, PBC), dataset sp500. Distributed by Rdatasets (https://github.com/vincentarelbundock/Rdatasets). The index is calculated by S&P Dow Jones Indices.
sp500.changes: Rows put in date order; the row-number column and the adjusted close, which equals the close on every day, dropped. The sample keeps the close of the last trading day of each week.

sunspots.title: Yearly sunspot numbers, 1700 to 1988

source.name: sunspot.year
source.publisher: R datasets package, as a CSV file in Rdatasets

sunspots.credit: Tong, H. (1996). Non-Linear Time Series. Clarendon Press, Oxford, p. 471. Distributed with R's datasets package and by Rdatasets (https://github.com/vincentarelbundock/Rdatasets).
sunspots.changes: The row-number column dropped, and the columns named year and sunspots.
